desktop_enable_help: Control the Windows Onmyoji client. Save and restart the script to apply.
game_path_help: Enter the directory containing bin/onmyoji.exe, or leave blank to search automatically.
profile_dir_help: Use a separate directory per instance to keep account data separate. Leave blank to use the default account data.
window_pos_help: Enter x,y (for example, 0,0), or leave blank to keep the current position.
window_title_help: Give this instance a distinct taskbar title, or leave blank to keep the game's title.
launch_instance_help: Enable desktop mode and save your settings before launching the game.
desktop_launch_failed: Could not launch the desktop client. Check the OAS backend log.
restart_when_window_exists: Force restart if a window is open
restart_when_window_exists_help: Allow the Restart task to close and relaunch an existing desktop client.
